Dear colleagues,
Mr. Florent from Engie raised a ticket regarding Failsafemode. It seems that Router 1 is not turning ON. Please take a spare router to site and change it if you cannot access it.
Please check if the router has 24V supply, LEDs ON and connection to 10.20.17.1. Also check if possibly it reverted to factory settings for a unknown reason in 192.168.1.1.
Customer says it has OCPP connection.
